craft_notes: Sthāyin: analogy-joy (first dhāraṇā-block verse; door requested v23 answered retroactively). Sanskrit: yathālokena dīpasya...tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ → L4 keeps both halves of the yathā/tadvac frame uncut. Rows: row 3 (as-so logical pair). Close: dear (vocative echo of the turn). Rejected: 'comparison' — killed: 'as...so' kept as plain simile; dropping O dear — killed: intimate register starts here.

lines: As lamp-light, rays, and sun disclose
direction and division — so by power, Śiva, O dear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

reads_against.argmap: How is Śiva known by power? → Analogy: just as light reveals directions, power reveals Śiva.
c1_essence: Lamp-ray-sun known so by power Śiva known.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
